instruction: Stand in the middle of the main room, about 2 m back from the short wall on the right that runs from the corner by the tall cabinet toward the door alcove (wall w0). Point the phone at the corner where that wall meets the long back wall. Sweep slowly from floor to ceiling, covering the first metre of the wall out from that corner. Keep the phone moving smoothly and make sure the top of the wall near the ceiling is in view. Then finish the scan as usual.
reason: The scan is almost ready. The room's size, the ceiling, the window and the door into the hallway were all captured. The door measures 0.77 m wide and 2.07 m high, though the width could be off by about 3 cm either way. One spot is missing: the first 0.94 m of wall w0 next to the corner, from floor to ceiling, about 1 m² in total. The scanner got no data there at all, and nothing was blocking it. The missing patch is wedge-shaped and widest at the top, so it looks like the phone just didn't sweep that part. It still needs checking, because that patch could hide a radiator, a socket, a recess or an opening, and any of those would change what fits against that wall. Every other gap is small or sits behind furniture, which is fine.
